name: FindAndReplaceInDocxFile
label: Find and Replace in DOCX file
description: Finds text and replaces it with another in a .docx document using Open XML SDK.

fields.name: DocumentPath
fields.label: Document Path
fields.description: The full file path to the .docx document.

fields.name: AllMatches
fields.label: All Matches
fields.description: Specifies whether to replace all occurrences or just the first one.

fields.name: TextToFind
fields.label: Text to Find
fields.description: The text to search for in the document.

fields.name: TextToReplaceWith
fields.label: Text to Replace With
fields.description: The text to replace the found text with.

fields.name: UseRegex
fields.label: Use Regular Expressions
fields.description: If enabled, 'Text to Find' is treated as a .NET regular expression.

fields.name: SaveDocument
fields.label: Save Document
fields.description: Automatically saves the Word document after replacement.
